_meta.purpose: In-market local TV and streaming for each team, 2026-27. Replaces data/local_tv.json in jsierrahoopshype/nba-watch-guide.

confidence_rules.high: Official 2026-27 source. Counts in coverage maths.
confidence_rules.moderate: Dated 2026 secondary reporting. Counts in coverage maths but must render a check-before-you-buy note.
confidence_rules.low: Conflicting or stale sources. Never counts in coverage maths. Page shows what is known plus 'Local details for 2026-27 not confirmed yet.'
confidence_rules.unknown: Not announced. Never counts. Page says so plainly.

coverage_rules.scope: Local options only cover the team's games that have no national broadcaster, and only for a reader in the team's market.
coverage_rules.ota_all: ota.status 'all' means every local game is free over the air: counts as free coverage for every non-national game.
coverage_rules.ota_partial: ota.status 'partial' or 'most' is NOT coverage. We do not know which games. Render as a text line only.
coverage_rules.streaming: A streaming option with a non-null monthly_price_usd covers every non-national game at that monthly price. A null price means it is listed but cannot enter a priced combination.
